comments.body:
It's definitely frustrating losing all the progress on a large download. 

It happened to me too while pulling a image, and wondering if there's a solution to it because imo resuming a partially downloaded blob exactly where it left off is complex and not a standard behavior in most container runtimes yet.

No it is not difficult, this problem exists for probably decades and has already been solved in other applications. Maybe use/analyse wget??? Afaik it has a continue option. This is also a huge resource waste.

And the other thing I would reconsider is this 3GB layer, I assume this is cuda/gpu stuff, you do not need to download that all the time. I can't really imagine you have code changes of 3GB. So use layers more efficiently.
